title: eliokarmos pilosus subsp. bergii
intro: Eliokarmos pilosus subsp. bergii, commonly known as the Berg's Eliokarmos, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues.
